metadata.title: On a Class of Non-Local Elliptic-Transport Systems in Score-Guided Probability Flow on $SE(3)$: Score-Singularity Resolution, Space-Time ADN Shift, and Markov Mean-Field Games
metadata.abstract: We establish mathematical foundations for optimal spatiotemporal vector fields governing continuous score-guided probability flows over bounded submanifolds $M \subset SE(3)$ on the Special Euclidean group $SE(3) \cong \mathbb{R}^3 \times SO(3)$. Modeling dynamic density evolution via a score-perturbed Lie-algebraic continuity equation under zero-flux boundary conditions, we resolve the non-local score drift singularity $s(g,t) = \nabla_{SE(3)} \log \rho(g,t)$ as $\rho \rightarrow 0^+$ via weighted parabolic flux dissipation bounds. Using left-invariant exponential group mollifiers, we derive boundary-preserving DiPerna--Lions commutator estimates tracking structure constants $\{c_{ij}^k\}$. Second, interpreting the optimality system as a 7D space-time elliptic operator $L_{7D} = -\Delta_{SE(3)} - \partial_t^2$ with zero-order corner compatibility on $\partial M \times \{0,T\}$, we establish Agmon--Douglis--Nirenberg $W_p^2(Q_T)$ shift estimates tracking Lie algebra constants, boundary geometry $\|\partial M\|_{C^2}$, and Ricci curvature $\|Ric_{SE(3)}\|_{L^\infty}$, yielding a full $C^\infty(\overline{Q}_T)$ Schauder bootstrap expansion. Third, we extend this system to non-cooperative Markov Mean-Field Games (MFGs) on $SE(3)$, establishing score-guided Nash equilibria via Schauder--Tychonoff fixed points. Crucially, the constant diagonal Ricci curvature $Ric_{SE(3)} = \mathrm{diag}(0,0,0,1/2,1/2,1/2)$ from $SO(3)$ induces a sharp Bochner--Weitzenböck spectral gap boost $\lambda_1(-\Delta_{SE(3)}) \ge \lambda_1(-\Delta_{\mathbb{R}^3}) + 1/2 > 0$. This positive rotational curvature enhances the Lie-algebraic Poincaré coercivity constant, demonstrating that intrinsic group curvature stabilizes score-guided flows against dispersion and expands the critical Nash uniqueness horizon $T_{SE(3)}^*$ beyond flat Euclidean limits.

analysis.workSummary: 作者在SE(3)有界子域零通量边界上研究score扰动连续性方程，主张以加权耗散处理ρ→0的logρ漂移奇性，建立保边界交换子、时空椭圆ADN移位估计及光滑bootstrap，并经固定点得到Markov平均场Nash均衡。还声称旋转正Ricci产生谱隙提升和更长唯一性时间。
analysis.breakthrough: 尝试把群几何、奇异score漂移与平均场系统统一。
analysis.limitations: 摘要中的普遍谱隙相加公式及由角点零阶相容推全边界C∞提升均需严格检查域、边界条件和高阶相容；不能仅由SO(3)正Ricci即认定任意子域函数的标量谱隙加1/2。当前按作者主张记录而非已独立确认。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
